question: O Local Encoder substitui completamente o Web Encoder?

Local-Encoder: Local Encoder complements the Web Encoder
Using it for uploads does not make the Web Encoder optional

must_state: No: Local Encoder complements the Web Encoder, which must stay configured in the Encoder URL
Features that still use the Web Encoder (e.g. VideoThumbnails sprites, MP4ThumbsAndGif, live previews, recorded lives, Meet/Zoom/mobile uploads, playlists played live, embed-link metadata)
Local Encoder accepts single video links, not playlist or channel imports
must_not_state: That the Web Encoder can be removed or the Encoder URL pointed at Local Encoder
Speed gains as guaranteed (the page says they depend on hardware, video and qualities)

question: Por que minhas miniaturas de navegação não aparecem?

VideoThumbnails-Plugin: Previews are made only for videos hosted on your site
Technical-Plugin-VideoThumbnails: Generates seek-bar preview sprites using the Web Encoder

must_state: Clarify or cover both readings: seek-bar previews (VideoThumbnails sprite) and video thumbnail images
The sprite is built by the Web Encoder, which must be online and able to download the video from the site
Checks: wait and reload after the first view; embedded videos get no preview; createStprits lines in the log
Possible causes presented as checks, not as a confirmed diagnosis
must_not_state: That VideoThumbnails is a free plugin
A certain cause without the user's logs

question: Qual a diferença entre o plugin WebRTC e os recursos premium do WebRTC2RTMP?

WebRTC-plugin: The plugin is free and included in AVideo
Without premium, broadcasts carry a watermark and have lower limits

must_state: The WebRTC plugin is free; premium refers to WebRTC2RTMP server limits (concurrent broadcasts, minutes per broadcast) and watermark removal
Requirements: Live plugin with a live server, Scheduler with cron, HTTPS, port 3000 open
Plans per domain: Starter $10/month (2 streams, 2 h), Basic $20/month (5, 4 h), Pro $30/month (10, 6 h), Unlimited $50/month, Lifetime $1000 one-time; Unlimited included with our hosting
Plan details cited from the PDF by file name and page or from the marketplace page
must_not_state: That the WebRTC plugin itself is paid
A wiki URL for the PDF
Unlimited video calls as a documented capability

question: Como usar armazenamento S3 no AVideo?

AWS_S3-Plugin: HLS videos, images and thumbnails stay on your server
Use-AWS-S3-on-AVideo-Platform: Files larger than 5 GB stay on your server

must_state: AWS_S3 is a paid add-on from the marketplace
Configured in Admin Panel > Settings > S3, B2, FTP settings (region, bucket_name, key, secret, endpoint for S3-compatible providers)
Only MP4, WebM and MP3 go to the bucket; HLS, images and thumbnails stay local
must_not_state: That HLS videos are stored in S3
A refusal to discuss Amazon S3 because of the CDN policy (it covers third-party CDNs, not storage plugins)

question: O pagamento foi aprovado, mas o acesso não foi liberado.

YPTWallet-Usage: The user paid but the balance did not change
Technical-Payments: A browser success message, approved agreement or funded wallet does not alone prove all three outcomes

must_state: Ask or cover which payment provider and which product (subscription, pay-per-view, live event, wallet credit)
Separate the three outcomes: payment settled at the provider, wallet credited, access fulfilled
Viewer: check the wallet balance/history and contact the site; administrator: provider webhook/IPN, AVideo log, wallet log
must_not_state: That access will certainly be released or by when
Advice to replay provider events or edit the database without checking the transaction first
